title: UC Davis - Glucagon Assay Protocol
author: Peter Havel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.63ihgke

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the enzyme conjugate 1X solution and the wash buffer 1X solution.

steps.title: Prepare Microplate
steps.instruction: Prepare sufficient microplate wells to accommodate Calibrators, controls, and samples in duplicate.

steps.title: Add Samples and Calibrators
steps.instruction: Pipette 10 µL each of Calibrators, controls, and samples into the appropriate wells.

steps.title: Add Enzyme Conjugate
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL enzyme conjugate 1X solution to each well and attach the plate sealer.

steps.title: Incubate Plate
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate on a shaker at 700-900 rpm overnight (18-22h) at 2–8ºC.

steps.title: Wash Microplate
steps.instruction: Wash the plate to remove unbound materials using one of two methods.

substeps.instruction: Automatic method: Wash 6 times with 700 µL wash buffer 1X solution per well using an automatic plate washer with overflow-wash function (do not include soak step).

Manual method: Discard reaction volume by inverting the plate over a sink; add 350 µL wash solution to each well; discard wash buffer 1X solution and tap firmly against absorbent paper. Repeat 5 times.
Final step: After the final wash, invert and tap the plate firmly against absorbent paper.

steps.title: Add Substrate
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Substrate TMB to each well.

steps.title: Incubate at Room Temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate on the bench for 30 minutes at room temperature (18–25ºC).

steps.title: Stop Reaction
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL Stop Solution to each well and place the plate on a shaker for approximately 5 seconds to ensure mixing.

steps.title: Read Optical Density
steps.instruction: Read the optical density at 450 nm and calculate results. The reading must be performed within 30 minutes.
